name: etoile-ballet-platform
description: Étoile Ballet Academy - Dual Portal Platform & NestJS Backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,CLIENT,ADMIN" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix admin run build && npm --prefix server run build && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r client/dist/* dist/ && mkdir -p dist/admin && cp -r admin/dist/* dist/admin/
scripts.docker:backup: mkdir -p backups && docker compose exec -T postgres pg_dump -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-root} ${POSTGRES_DB:-etoile} | gzip > backups/etoile-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql.gz && echo "Backup written to backups/"
scripts.docker:restore: echo 'Restore with: ./scripts/restore.sh backups/<file>.sql.gz --yes (local) or gunzip -c backups/<file>.sql.gz | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-root} ${POSTGRES_DB:-etoile}'
scripts.backup:cron: (crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo '17 2 * * * cd /Users/bishoy/Desktop/Etoile && bash scripts/backup.sh 14 >> backups/cron.log 2>&1') | crontab -
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix server install
